The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos . Its tags are Indicadores, Minuto Internacional, Red Fija, Tráfico entrante, Tráfico saliente. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-08-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
